verdict.rationale: n8n's own GitHub materials say you can combine visual building with JavaScript, Python and npm packages. A hands-on community report confirms there are custom code blocks for JS and Python inside workflows, though with limited ability to import libraries. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Code node itself (runtime, sandboxing, data access), clear evidence on Python library and npm import limits.
